steps.visible_text:
COT-START-S00-4C7B437FB7D0
Plan: write an intriguing opening paragraph, third-person or first-person, establishing character waking up with time travel ability, hook with sensory detail and a twist/question to pull reader in. Keep it concise, vivid, one paragraph.
COT-END-S00-4C7B437FB7D0

The first thing Mara noticed was that her coffee was still hot—impossibly, stubbornly hot—though the clock on her nightstand insisted she'd been staring at the ceiling for the better part of an hour. The second thing she noticed was the newspaper on her doormat, its date glaring up at her like an accusation: yesterday's. She should have been afraid. Instead, standing barefoot in the kitchen with steam curling from a mug she didn't remember pouring, Mara felt something unfamiliar bloom in her chest—not fear, but the dizzy, dangerous thrill of infinite mornings, each one hers to unmake and remake until she got it right.
